basic_info.description: Situated in a prime Noe location, less than two blocks to the heart of the 24th Street Corridor, is this inviting Victorian home. This charming residence has an abundance of period details, tall ceilings and an efficient floor-plan. The light filled living room has an ornate fireplace, built-in shelves and architectural details. The formal dining room opens to the kitchen which features a breakfast bar, plentiful counter space and ample cabinets. This home has two generous sized bedrooms and both are en-suite to full baths. One bath has a walk in shower and the other features a claw foot tub. Completing the main level is a rear den which overlooks the rear yard, has deck access and is ideal for a home office. The low maintenance yard takes advantage of the local microclimate and includes mature trees and synthetic grass. The garage includes parking, Washer & Dryer, abundant storage and a separate entrance. Bring your architect to explore adding living space in the big open garage.
